channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Banana Waste to Road Safety: How Kenya Is Turning Farm Leftovers Into Green Infrastructure
item.description: Kenya is transforming discarded banana stems into flexible, eco-friendly road dividers, creating safer roads, supporting farmers, and advancing a circular economy.

item.title: Republic Day: From Drafts to Democracy, How India Wrote Its Constitution
item.description: Drafted over nearly three years through intense debate and consensus, India’s Constitution laid the foundation of the world’s largest democracy when it came into force on January 26, 1950.

item.title: Kedarnath, Badrinath Consider Ban on Non-Hindu Entry Across 47 Affiliated Temples in Uttarakhand
item.description: Uttarakhand: Kedarnath, Badrinath to ban non-Hindu from entering? Here's what we know.

item.title: Nationwide Bank Strike On January 27 as Unions Demand Immediate 5-Day Work Week
item.description: Public sector bank employees across India strike on January 27, demanding a formal five-day work week amid rising workloads and staff shortages.

item.title: Died at the Doorstep of Care: How a Jammed Ambulance Exposed Madhya Pradesh’s Emergency Healthcare Crisis
item.description: A critically ill man died after a malfunctioning 108 ambulance delayed his transfer at a district hospital in Satna.

item.title: Kolkata Warehouse Fire Kills Seven, Over 20 Missing After Blaze Engulfs Anandapur Complex
item.description: A massive pre-dawn fire at a Nazirabad warehouse killed seven workers and left twenty-one others missing in Kolkata.

item.title: Inclusion or Division? UGC Equity Rules 2026 Ignite Nationwide Protests as Campuses Grapple With Fears of Polarisation
item.description: UGC’s new equity rules aim to curb discrimination in higher education but have sparked protests, resignations and a fierce national debate over fairness and implementation.

item.title: Mayank Pandey and Rashee Hosted a 2,500-Guest Wedding, But the Real Celebration Was Sustainability and Service
item.description: By putting service before spectacle and sustainability before excess, this couple reimagined what Indian weddings can stand for.

item.title: Wheelchair-Bound Army Veteran Stopped at Karnataka Toll Plaza Despite Exemption, Staff Issue Apology
item.description: Sasthan toll plaza staff apologised after a viral video showed them humiliating a wheelchair-bound war veteran.

item.title: Bakery Products Prepared by Prisoners Served at Republic Day Celebrations in Bengaluru’s Manekshaw Parade Ground
item.description: Karnataka’s Nav Sankalp programme trains prisoners in bakery skills, combining rehabilitation with skill-building and dignity.
